drhp.business: PhysicsWallah offers test preparation courses for competitive examinations (such as JEE, NEET, UPSC, GATE and other government examinations) and other courses such as upskilling. Delivery is through online channels (social media, website and apps), tech-enabled offline centers ('Vidyapeeth') and hybrid two-teacher centers ('Pathshala'). As at June 30, 2025 it offered courses across 13 Education Categories via 303 Total Offline Centers, monetising a large free YouTube/social-media community into free and paid users.

internal_operational.detail: Success depends on attracting and retaining students, and rising dropouts/refunds could adversely impact business and financials.
internal_operational.evidence: Number of student dropouts 46,019 in FY25 (7,993 in FY23; 33,769 in Q1 FY26); refunds to dropouts INR 261.45 million FY25 and INR 153.49 million Q1 FY26; dropouts 1.03% of paid users FY25
internal_operational.title: Ability to attract and retain students

internal_operational.detail: The business depends on retaining faculty, and high faculty attrition or inability to hire replacements could disrupt course delivery.
internal_operational.evidence: Faculty attrition rate (employee) 40.40% FY24, 26.98% FY25, 30.00% Q1 FY26; total faculty 6,267 (Q1 FY26); professional fees INR 2,170.29 million FY25; 11 GATE faculty left in Jan 2024
internal_operational.title: Ability to attract and retain faculty

internal_operational.detail: Business depends on continued leadership of founder-promoters Alakh Pandey and Prateek Boob and key employees, whose departure could adversely affect the business.
internal_operational.evidence: Employee attrition rate 45.27% FY24, 36.51% FY25, 37.72% Q1 FY26; employees 15,775 FY25; one employee filed labour-department complaint alleging wrongful termination practices
internal_operational.title: Dependence on founders and key management

internal_operational.detail: Must keep curriculum and content current with changing exam formats/syllabi, and failure to update in time could raise costs and reduce enrolments.
internal_operational.evidence: In Oct 2024 NTA reduced questions in a JEE Main 2025 section; in Nov 2023 NTA removed certain chapters from JEE Main syllabus, requiring content updates
internal_operational.title: Ability to provide updated/relevant content

internal_operational.detail: A significant portion of offline revenue comes from a few cities, exposing the company to concentration risk.
internal_operational.evidence: 303 Total Offline Centers across 152 cities as at June 30, 2025; Delhi NCR 11.24%, Patna 9.45% of offline revenue FY25; Kota enrolments fell from 27,158 (FY23) to 11,540 (FY25); Calicut offline revenue fell from INR 341.36M to INR 240.17M
internal_operational.title: Geographic concentration of offline centers

internal_operational.detail: The PhysicsWallah brand is critical; negative media/social-media publicity or failure to maintain the brand could materially harm reputation and operations.
internal_operational.evidence: Advertisement and publicity expenses INR 2,762.32 million (9.57% of revenue) FY25, INR 1,178.53 million Q1 FY26; instances of teacher-conduct videos going viral in 2023-2024
internal_operational.title: Brand dependence and negative publicity

internal_operational.detail: Failure to protect student safety and security could damage reputation and reduce enrolments.
internal_operational.evidence: FIR dated June 11, 2024 after a ceiling fan fell on a student at a New Delhi center (since settled/disposed); 2024 unidentified-odour evacuation at a Utkarsh center with students referred to hospital
internal_operational.title: Student safety and security

internal_operational.detail: Some offline centers run by third-party franchisees, over which the company has limited operational and compliance control, may harm brand and revenue.
internal_operational.evidence: Company's share ranges 15% to 90% of net fees collected by franchisees; unit franchisee may terminate on up to 90 days' notice before next academic year; franchisee agreement terms up to five years
internal_operational.title: Limited control over franchisee-operated centers

internal_operational.detail: Failure to continue developing the technology stack or introduce new tech-backed tools could erode competitiveness.
internal_operational.evidence: Server expenses INR 615.71 million (2.13%) and technology expenses INR 122.18 million (0.42%) of revenue FY25
internal_operational.title: Development of technology stack

internal_operational.detail: Disruptions in availability of social media channels, website or apps could adversely affect operations.
internal_operational.evidence: One instance of interruption experienced in each of Q1 FY26 and Fiscals 2025, 2024, 2023; Oct 2022 Android app crashes; Aug 2023 authentication failure; Nov 2023 video player issue; Sept 2024 API 'not found' errors
internal_operational.title: Website/app availability and systems failures

internal_operational.detail: All offline centers and the Registered and Corporate Office are on leased/licensed property; non-renewal or termination could disrupt operations.
internal_operational.evidence: Total rental expenses INR 1,987.70 million (6.89% of revenue) FY25, INR 620.97 million Q1 FY26; lease tenures range between 11 months and nine years
internal_operational.title: Dependence on leased/licensed premises

internal_operational.detail: Failure by third-party providers (cloud, hosting, payment, printing, franchisees) to perform could materially impact operations.
internal_operational.evidence: Third party expenses INR 13,218.00 million (45.79% of revenue) FY25, INR 4,609.54 million (54.42%) Q1 FY26
internal_operational.title: Dependence on third-party service providers

internal_operational.detail: Referral fraud, falsified onboarding, refund fraud or employee misappropriation could harm business, reputation and expose to liability.
internal_operational.evidence: FIR dated April 11, 2025 against employee Ram Jawahar alleging criminal breach of trust for non-deposit of fees at a Ghazipur, Delhi Pathshala center; insignificant fraud instances in FY25
internal_operational.title: Fraudulent transactions by students/employees

internal_operational.detail: Enrolments are tied to examination and result timelines, concentrating collections and revenue and causing quarter-to-quarter fluctuation.
internal_operational.evidence: Enrolments typically increase March to August; majority of revenue recognized in the second and third quarters of the fiscal year
internal_operational.title: Seasonality of enrolments

internal_operational.detail: Reliance on third-party insurance that may be inadequate to cover losses or liabilities from operations.
internal_operational.evidence: Insurance coverage as a percentage of book value of assets 36.13% FY25, 38.48% Q1 FY26, 32.25% FY23; book value of assets INR 3,700.00 million FY25
internal_operational.title: Inadequate insurance coverage

internal_operational.detail: Inability to use licensed or open-source software, or open-source licence disputes, could disrupt technology and business.
internal_operational.evidence: No instances faced in Q1 FY26 or Fiscals 2025, 2024, 2023, but risk of re-engineering technologies if licences are construed adversely
internal_operational.title: Reliance on third-party/open-source software

internal_operational.detail: Promoter, Whole-Time Director and CEO Alakh Pandey does not hold a formal higher educational degree.
internal_operational.evidence: Passed higher secondary from Bishop Johnson School and College, Prayagraj; over five years' experience in ed-tech; no formal higher educational degree
internal_operational.title: Promoter/CEO lacks formal higher educational degree

internal_operational.detail: Wide variety of accepted payment methods subjects the company to interchange fees, chargebacks and payment-network compliance risks.
internal_operational.evidence: Accepts credit/debit cards, digital wallets, UPI, cash and bank transfers; subject to payment card network operating rules and possible chargebacks
internal_operational.title: Third-party payment processing risks

internal_operational.detail: Actual or perceived cybersecurity/data/privacy breaches could interrupt operations and expose the company to liability and regulatory penalties.
internal_operational.evidence: In FY25 the ERP servers of subsidiary iNeuron were hacked and backend financial data compromised (restored from backup); DPDP Act and Draft DPDP Rules 2025 stipulate monetary penalties
internal_operational.title: Cybersecurity, data or privacy breach

strategy_growth.detail: Enrolments are concentrated in a few Education Categories; failure to sustain these or grow others could hurt operations.
strategy_growth.evidence: Q1 FY26 online transacting users: NEET 26.64%, JEE 15.63%, Other government exams 12.33%, Foundation 17.61%; NEET transacting users 560,289 (Q1 FY26)
strategy_growth.title: Category concentration in NEET/JEE/Government/Foundation

strategy_growth.detail: Exact locations for new offline centers are not identified and no definitive arrangements exist, with costs based on vendor quotations/estimates.
strategy_growth.evidence: INR 4,605.51 million of Net Proceeds for company centers plus INR 316.48 million invested in Xylem for New Xylem Centers; costs based on vendor quotations/management estimates
strategy_growth.title: Undefined locations / no definitive arrangements for Net Proceeds

strategy_growth.detail: Under six years of operating history, especially in offline/hybrid channels and integrating acquisitions, makes long-term trends hard to predict.

strategy_growth.title: Limited operating history and rapid growth

strategy_growth.evidence: Acquisitions include Xylem 64.98%, Utkarsh 63.25%, Knowledge Planet 100%, PrepOnline/Penpencil/iNeuron 100%; Xylem Kerala premises pending fire NOC; iNeuron Sections 42/62 non-compliance
strategy_growth.title: Strategic acquisitions and integration risk

strategy_growth.detail: Proposed opening of new offline centers is subject to unanticipated delays and cost overruns.
strategy_growth.evidence: Risks include labour shortages, equipment/manpower cost increases, regulatory restrictions and approval delays
strategy_growth.title: Expansion delays and cost overruns

strategy_growth.detail: Significant expansion into offline channels increases setup, manpower and location-related risks.
strategy_growth.evidence: INR 5,140.72 million of Net Proceeds for company offline/hybrid centers plus INR 368.50 million for New Xylem Centers

strategy_growth.detail: Intense competition from organized players and independent teachers could force fee reductions or higher discounts.
strategy_growth.evidence: India test-prep market INR 1-1.1 trillion FY25, projected ~13% CAGR to INR 1.9-2.1 trillion by FY30; more than 13 M&A deals in CY2024; peers include Veranda Learning and Unacademy

strategy_growth.detail: Any variation in the use of Net Proceeds requires prior shareholders' approval, which may not be obtained timely.
strategy_growth.evidence: Sections 13(8) and 27 of the Companies Act require a special resolution through postal ballot to vary Objects
strategy_growth.title: Variation in utilization of Net Proceeds requires shareholder approval

strategy_growth.detail: Funds earmarked for inorganic growth through unidentified acquisitions may be insufficient, requiring alternative funding.
strategy_growth.evidence: Cumulative amount for inorganic growth and general corporate purposes shall not exceed 35% of the amount raised
strategy_growth.title: Net Proceeds for unidentified acquisitions may be insufficient

strategy_growth.detail: Proposed deployment of Net Proceeds is based on management estimates and not appraised by any bank or financial institution.
strategy_growth.evidence: Objects of the Offer not appraised by any bank, financial institution or independent agency

strategy_growth.detail: Operations in the Middle East and the newly incorporated US entity expose the company to cross-border legal, political and economic risks.
strategy_growth.evidence: Knowledge Planet centers across UAE, Oman and Saudi Arabia; Physics Wallah, Inc. incorporated July 31, 2024 (not yet operational)
strategy_growth.title: International operations risk (Middle East, US)

strategy_growth.detail: Industry data is derived from a Redseer report commissioned and paid for by the company, subject to inherent limitations.
strategy_growth.evidence: 'Education Market in India' report dated September 3, 2025 by Redseer, exclusively commissioned and paid for by the Company
strategy_growth.title: Reliance on commissioned Redseer Report

strategy_growth.detail: Force-majeure-type events could materially and adversely affect business, financial condition and results.
strategy_growth.evidence: References to COVID-19, H7N9/H5N1/H1N1, Russia-Ukraine war, Israel-Gaza unrest
